bagPolicy.summary: All bags will be searched upon entry. Bags smaller than 6” x 9” x 2” are allowed, including clear bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available at the Cox Center parking garage, accessible from EK Gaylord. Additional parking options may be available nearby in downtown Oklahoma City and Bricktown.

rideshare.note: Uber and Lyft pickup and drop-off is at Second Street and Harvey Avenue on the west side of the arena.

concessions.note: Paycom Center offers a variety of food and drink options including hot dogs, nachos, pizza, and specialty items like Big O's BBQ and Freddy's burgers. Beverage options include bottomless souvenir sodas, draft beers, and bottled water. Some stands may not be open during concerts and special events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Buy wheelchair-accessible seats online or at the box office, and say you need accessible seating when you order; you can add up to three companion seats. Free assistive listening devices are at the Guest Relations desk inside the northeast entrance, across from Section 105, with an ID deposit. A quiet sensory space is next to First Aid at Section 112.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Bring the purchase credit card, valid photo ID and order confirmation to the box office. Will call is available during business hours starting 48 hours after purchase or on show day. Check the event page for exceptions.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Thunder doors open 90 minutes before tipoff. Concert door times vary. Check the event page or call 405-602-8700 for your show.
